description: Figure 8 is a line plot illustrating the accuracy comparison between Experiment 1 (Ex1) and Experiment 2 (Ex2) during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The horizontal x-axis, labeled "Step," is linear and ranges from 0 to 60,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)," is linear and spans from 0.10 to 0.40, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains two lines: a solid blue line with circular markers representing "Ex1 Accuracy," and a solid green line with circular markers representing "Ex2 Accuracy." Both lines show a sharp initial increase in accuracy from the start (Step 0) to approximately Step 5,000. After this initial rise, the Ex1 Accuracy line continues to climb steadily, reaching a plateau near 0.40 by Step 40,000. The Ex2 Accuracy line also increases after Step 5,000 but at a slower rate, plateauing at a lower value of approximately 0.38 by Step 40,000. Throughout the entire training stage, the Ex1 Accuracy line remains consistently above the Ex2 Accuracy line.
